name: Screen control
author: Saeed
description: Lets Saeed see the screen and use the mouse and keyboard to work inside other programs, such as a company system. Windows only. It asks your permission for each task, shows a red STOP bar, and Ctrl+Alt+X stops it at once.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the main screen. Mouse coordinates used by the other screen tools are pixels of THIS image. Always take one before acting.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Do 1 to 15 steps with the mouse and keyboard, then return a new screenshot. Steps: {action:'click',x,y,button?:'left'|'right'|'middle',count?:1|2}, {action:'move',x,y}, {action:'drag',x,y,x2,y2}, {action:'scroll',x?,y?,amount} (positive amount = down), {action:'type',text} (types into the focused field, any language), {action:'key',keys:'enter'|'tab'|'ctrl+s'|'alt+f4'|'f5'...}, {action:'wait',ms}. Click a field before typing in it. Do small steps and check the screenshot after each batch.

tools.name: windows
tools.description: List the open windows, or bring one to the front by part of its title.

settings.label: Never act in windows whose title contains
settings.default: Task Manager, Registry Editor, Windows Security, Command Prompt, PowerShell, Windows Terminal, Group Policy, Computer Management, User Account Control, BitLocker
